          definition:
          users:Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u | u.SuspensionDays > 0)
            
            precondition:
          users.isEmpty() = false
            
            postcondition:
          users->forAll(u:User | u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre - 1 and (u.SuspensionDays = 0 implies u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND) and (u.SuspensionDays > 0 implies u.BorrowStatus = u.BorrowStatus@pre))
